official UN target text: By 2030, double the global rate of improvement in energy efficiency
note: Energy conservation is a primary operational mechanism for driving improvements in energy efficiency.

official UN target text: Enhance the Global Partnership for Sustainable Development, complemented by multi-stakeholder partnerships that mobilize and share knowledge, expertise, technology and financial resources, to support the achievement of the Sustainable Development Goals in all countries, in particular developing countries
note: Internal corporate coordination does not constitute an intergovernmental global sustainable development partnership.

official UN target text: Strengthen the capacity of domestic financial institutions to encourage and expand access to banking, insurance and financial services for all
note: Relevant if the financial service offering specifically expands access to underserved banking and insurance populations.

official UN target text: Encourage companies, especially large and transnational companies, to adopt sustainable practices and to integrate sustainability information into their reporting cycle
note: Relevant if external factor analysis explicitly covers ESG risks and sustainability reporting trends.

official UN target text: Promote development-oriented policies that support productive activities, decent job creation, entrepreneurship, creativity and innovation, and encourage the formalization and growth of micro-, small- and medium-sized enterprises, including through access to financial services
note: Forecasting company financials does not constitute enacting development-oriented public policies.

official UN target text: By 2030, reduce the adverse per capita environmental impact of cities, including by paying special attention to air quality and municipal and other waste management
note: Explicitly addresses managing municipal and operational waste to reduce per capita urban environmental impact.

official UN target text: Ensure equal opportunity and reduce inequalities of outcome, including by eliminating discriminatory laws, policies and practices and promoting appropriate legislation, policies and action in this regard
note: Complying with environmental statutes does not address legal discrimination or social inequality of opportunity.

official UN target text: By 2030, achieve the sustainable management and efficient use of natural resources
note: Directly advises organizations on instituting sustainable management and resource-efficient operational policies.

official UN target text: By 2030, ensure that all learners acquire the knowledge and skills needed to promote sustainable development, including, among others, through education for sustainable development and sustainable lifestyles, human rights, gender equality, promotion of a culture of peace and non-violence, global citizenship and appreciation of cultural diversity and of culture's contribution to sustainable development
note: Technical building standards relate to architectural engineering, not learner education or curricula.

official UN target text: Strengthen efforts to protect and safeguard the world's cultural and natural heritage
note: Relevant only if the environmental efforts specifically safeguard recognized natural heritage sites or ecosystems.

note: Relevant if the financing is explicitly directed toward capital retrofits and clean industrial upgrades.
